items.title: 108 leads frozen since pipeline launch (2025-10-29), never touched
items.summary: 100 of 120 'Far Out (Cold)' opportunities and 8 of 56 'Later Date (Warm)' opportunities share the exact same lastStageChangeAt timestamp (2025-10-29 / 2025-10-11), right around when this pipeline was created (2025-10-09). This looks like a bulk migration batch that was never individually worked, not 108 leads that independently went stale — worth auditing as one batch, not one by one.

items.title: Workflow bug: Ben (Burlington) — 99 days from stage entry to visit

items.title: One cycle from abandonment: Abdul Khaliq (Later Date/Warm)

items.title: Meeting stage: 35 of 49 opps over threshold or near abandonment
items.summary: 13 are past the 30-day stale point untagged, 22 already carry stale_lead and are past (or nearly past) the 60-day abandonment point, and 8 more are approaching it. There is no follow-up sequence for this stage yet per the workflow notes — this is the backlog Albert is designing the sequence to fix.

items.title: +13 lower-priority conversations and drift findings not itemized
items.summary: 13 more of today's active conversations (routine logistics, existing customers, resolved calls) and additional stale/abandonment-risk opportunities beyond the ones itemized above are captured in full in extensions.ghl.conversations and extensions.ghl.workflow_drift, which are not subject to the item cap.

needs_attention: Vic Montero's install date is being renegotiated (Aug 4 -> Aug 27 offered) and still needs an explicit written confirmation back to him today.
Helena reported two more cracked tiles on a past install; warranty claim form was sent today and needs to be tracked to completion.

108 opportunities (100 Cold + 8 Warm) share the exact same stage-entry timestamp from pipeline launch (2025-10-29) and have never been individually worked — this is a bulk-import backlog, not organic staleness; worth a batch decision rather than one-by-one triage.

3 of today's active conversations show real, answered calls (93s-610s) on contacts that remain completely untagged and never entered the call queue — (416) 945-5049, (905) 609-3096, and Karim. Direct contact happened but categorization never followed.
17 contacts have sat in the call queue 24h+ (up to 310h / ~13 days for Premlata Kapoor) with only call-queue and no lead: tag ever applied.

Bushrra Chaudhry and Luigi Marchesi (Postponed stage) and Abdul Khaliq (Warm stage) are all well past the documented 2x auto-abandonment point (up to 530 days) and still show status=open — the auto-abandon step does not appear to be firing for these stages.

Two Meeting-scheduled appointments (Silviya, Ben/Burlington) were booked so far out after stage entry that the 30-day follow-up window was already negative before the visit happened — a workflow timing bug, not a rep failure.
Two new leads today (Shaheen Sheikh, Baba) enabled Do Not Disturb within minutes of the automated intro SMS/call, closing off further automated outreach — both need a manual call instead.

exclusions._comment: Reconciles the netted metrics back to raw. Excluded records are NOT dropped — they stay in conversations[]/new_leads[] carrying the flag that excluded them.

reporting.leads_by_tag_note: Counts are across all 254 currently-open opportunities in the two project pipelines (not lifetime). A handful of contacts carry more than one lead: tag simultaneously (e.g. a test contact tagged both cold and warm), so the tag counts sum to slightly more than 254 minus untagged.
reporting.avg_days_in_stage_note: Cold and Postponed averages are heavily skewed by a ~108-contact bulk-import batch frozen since pipeline launch (2025-10-29/2025-10-11) and two 530-day Postponed records — see workflow_drift stale_approaching/abandonment_next.
reporting.opportunity_status_counts_note: Across all three pipelines combined, lifetime totals (not a daily metric). Matches the documented ~297 won / ~1,132 abandoned scale.
reporting.store_pipeline_note: STORE: Material Pipeline has 48 open / 6 won / 7 lost / 2 abandoned (63 total). Retail material sales, distinct from project work. No stale thresholds are defined for this pipeline (it runs its own +3d/+8d automated cadence) so no staleness prediction is made here.

stale_thresholds_used._comment: Echoed from platform-settings/ghl-workflow.json so the output is self-describing and a threshold change is visible in the diff.

meeting_window_summary._comment: The window any new Meeting-scheduled follow-up sequence must fit inside. Threshold counts from stage entry, so appointments booked far out shrink the usable runway.

reporting.followup_not_fired_check_note: Scoped this run to the 0c. ASAP (Hot) stage (3 contacts) and today's active conversations rather than a full-account scan of every mobile-quote-tagged contact. No violations found in Hot (both mobile-quote follow-ups sent ~3.5 days ago, within the 5-day window). A full sweep of Warm/Cold for overdue quote follow-ups was not performed this run given volume — recommend as a follow-up analysis.
